## 4. Version marks are new cards, not reprints

Name suffixes: X 59, XV 24, LT 4, Ω 2; card numbers with RV (revival): 322. Each has its own name and rewritten text (for example "Reanimate LT" adds a Main effect to the old Flash), so each needs its own effects. They are recent cards, so they rank by their Saga like any other card.
